description: This file contains extension methods for configuring services and authentication in an ASP.NET Core application, specifically for the Conduit project. It includes methods to add core services, JWT authentication, and Serilog logging.

classes.name: ServicesExtensions
classes.description: Static class providing extension methods for configuring services, JWT authentication, and logging in an ASP.NET Core application.

methods.name: AddConduit
methods.description: Configures core application services including MediatR, validation, AutoMapper, and dependency injection for various interfaces.

methods.name: AddJwt
methods.description: Sets up JWT authentication with token validation parameters and event handling for token extraction from headers.

methods.name: AddSerilogLogging
methods.description: Configures Serilog logging with console sink and attaches it to the ILoggerFactory.
